name: mcpwatch-repo
description: MCPWatch: the engine (@vedhaai/mcpwatch), the dashboard backend (@vedhaai/mcpwatch-dashboard) and its frontend

scripts.build: npm run build -w engine && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w engine && concurrently -k -n engine,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w engine" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w engine && npm test -w backend
